title: Floppy Capacity Misconception

scenes.text: Floppy disks were once limited to exactly 1.44 MB of data
Many think every floppy could only store 1.44 MB
scenes.label: Universal 1.44 MB belief

scenes.text: In fact there were 720 KB, 1.2 MB, 1.44 MB, and even 2.88 MB formats, varying by density and drive
scenes.label: Multiple floppy sizes

scenes.text: Next time pick the right drive—floppy sizes were never one‑size‑fits‑all
scenes.label: Varied Formats

scenes.text: Follow for daily tech you should actually know.

description: We bust the idea that all floppy disks held exactly 1.44 MB. Learn about the multiple formats that existed. Follow for more tech myth busting!
